description: Every original photo, paired with its rendered view. Compare the rooms, details and garden of Webster House.
notes: Furniture, lighting and landscaping are staged. Camera positions and hidden dimensions are approximate. Photo 22 is a separate photo-derived closet study, not part of the whole-house model. Image 31 is a floor plan, included as a supporting reference.

pairs.title: Front of the house
pairs.note: Continuous tiled roof coverage; no added roof-edge parapets. Porch and terrace railings retained.

pairs.title: Living room · fireplace
pairs.note: Large side window / flush fireplace / small side window; rear blackboard and open shelves restored.

pairs.title: Living room · entry
pairs.note: Front triple window and cased entry arch retained. Furnishings are added staging.

pairs.title: Dining room · kitchen doorway
pairs.note: Black rectangular cage pendant, doorway positions, upper divided sashes and clear lower panes.

pairs.title: Dining room · French doors
pairs.note: French doors with full-height glazed sidelights; original cage pendant retained.

pairs.title: Kitchen · long view
pairs.note: Refrigerator, cooktop and wall-oven run recessed to clear both original kitchen doorways.

pairs.title: Kitchen · sink and cabinets
pairs.note: Hollow divided-glass upper cabinets, single sink, dishwasher and ornamental tile band.

pairs.title: Kitchen · appliances
pairs.note: Wall oven and range cabinetry retain their dimensions and fixture types; the complete west run is set back 60 cm.

pairs.title: Laundry
pairs.note: Top-loading laundry appliances and upper cabinets retained.

pairs.title: Family room
pairs.note: Projecting rear bay, French doors, corner windows, closet and square ceiling fixture.

pairs.title: Main-floor bedroom · front
pairs.note: Bedroom closet, double-hung window and square ceiling fixture retained.

pairs.title: Main-floor bedroom · rear
pairs.note: Rear bedroom closet and corner shelves; matching six-over-one rear windows.

pairs.title: Main bathroom · sink
pairs.note: Pedestal sink, mirror, toilet and frosted sash restored; previous fitted vanity removed.

pairs.title: Main bathroom · tub and shower
pairs.note: Separate tub and glass shower, brass fittings, peach/blue checker tile.

pairs.title: Primary suite · side windows
pairs.note: Primary suite alternate view: side sash windows, bathroom connection and staged furnishings.

pairs.title: Entry and staircase
pairs.note: Enclosed carpeted stair and white iron rail retained.

pairs.title: Bedroom · terrace doors
pairs.note: Slider to the enclosed terrace; closet and original sconce style. Furniture is added.

pairs.title: Walk-in closet
pairs.note: Closet storage and narrow window; closet dimensions remain inferred from the schematic plan.

pairs.title: Upper bedroom · rear
pairs.note: Two paired rear window units with four tall panes; square ceiling panel.

pairs.title: Hall bathroom
pairs.note: Paired window above tub, two checker-tile rows, pedestal sink and twin-shade wall light.

pairs.title: Primary suite · front window
pairs.note: Primary-suite reverse angle: the front picture window, transom, side sashes and original window AC.

pairs.title: Primary suite · reverse view
pairs.note: Primary-suite doors and east windows retained. Bed, rugs and table lamps are staging.

pairs.title: Closet · leaded windows
pairs.note: Photo-based closet study: leaded windows, hanging rails and stair enclosure. Hidden dimensions and the stair junction are inferred.

pairs.title: Primary bathroom · vanity
pairs.note: Double oval basins with actual bowl recesses, granite top, paired rear window, twin brass sconces.

pairs.title: Primary bathroom · shower
pairs.note: Brass/glass shower, larger checker granite accents and toiletry recess detail.

pairs.title: Powder room
pairs.note: White vanity, mirrored medicine cabinet, vertical bar light and floral stained-glass interpretation.

pairs.title: Bedroom · reverse view
pairs.note: Frosted six-over-one window and dark wall sconces restored; the window’s hidden adjacency is inferred.

pairs.title: Patio and outbuildings
pairs.note: Brick patio, detached garage and garden shed retained; landscaped/staged garden is intentional.

pairs.title: Back garden · wide view
pairs.note: Stepped rear massing, narrower upper gable, four clear panes and rectangular gable vent.

pairs.title: Rear of the house
pairs.note: Family-room projection, return window, matching bedroom windows, left-side rail and wider brick patio.

pairs.title: Side entrance and driveway
pairs.note: Garden window, glazed side door and side eaves; recessed entrance, original shutters, trellis and window AC restored.

heading: Webster House, side by side.
